---
title: "Open problems"
---

Questions LENS cannot yet answer, collected from seminars, concept pages, and discussion. Each
item records who raised it and where. When a question is resolved, or turns into a project,
note it here rather than deleting it.

To add one, open an
["Open question" issue](https://github.com/lens-program/knowledge-base/issues/new?template=open-question.yml)
or edit this page.

## From the LENS charter

These are the questions on the [LENS Program page](https://lens-program.github.io/lens-program/).

1. What are the relationships among identifiability, partial identifiability, practical
   identifiability, and recoverability?
2. Which parameters or functionals remain recoverable when a full model is nonidentifiable?
3. How can recoverability be characterized or diagnosed?
4. How do priors, constraints, measurement error, and external information affect what can be
   learned?
5. How do spatial and hierarchical structures influence identifiability?
6. How do likelihood-based and objective-function approaches relate?
7. How should we represent uncertainty when information varies across model components?

## Raised in concept pages

- Is there one definition that covers parameters, estimands, and states?

- Checking structural identifiability for high-dimensional hierarchical and spatial models.
  ([Structural non-identifiability](concepts/structural-non-identifiability.qmd))
- A definition of practical identifiability that does not depend on the inferential framework.
  ([Practical identifiability](concepts/practical-identifiability.qmd))
- Reporting uncertainty that is part reducible, part irreducible.
  ([Partial identification](concepts/partial-identification.qmd))
- One definition of recoverability, or several labelled ones?
  ([Recoverability](concepts/recoverability.qmd))
